stories.title: EY links customer service transformation to GCCs
stories.summary: EY suggests that Global Capability Centers are essential for scaling AI-native customer service. The firm notes that 40% to 50% of service interactions have self-service potential, provided companies implement the right operating model. The firm is currently advising clients on how to capture that value.

stories.title: PwC adds coffee machine to AI lab
stories.summary: PwC has installed a coffee machine in its AI lab. The firm did not provide further details on the machine's role in its artificial intelligence strategy.

stories.title: ASIC investigates KPMG over Macquarie audit tender
stories.summary: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission is scrutinizing KPMG’s successful bid for the Macquarie Group audit, a contract worth 95 million Australian dollars annually. The regulator is examining the use of confidential information and potential conflicts of interest during the tender process. The audit remains under review.

stories.title: Accenture says AI agents may influence half of holiday spending
stories.summary: Accenture’s latest survey suggests nearly half of consumers expect AI to influence at least 50% of their holiday spending in 2026. While 40% of shoppers plan to use generative AI to find deals and compare products, the firm notes that expectations are changing quickly among consumers.

stories.title: EY positions agentic AI as the next step for procurement
stories.summary: EY describes agentic AI as a fundamental shift for procurement, moving beyond simple automation toward greater autonomy and adaptability. The firm’s latest whitepaper suggests this technology will allow organizations to make decisions faster and manage complexity. Procurement is currently entering a defining moment.

stories.title: Deloitte identifies originality gap in AI adoption
stories.summary: Deloitte reports that while AI is abundant across APEC economies, originality remains scarce. The firm argues that as intelligence becomes commoditized, business advantage will come from what cannot be bought. Leading this transition is now defined as the primary job of the CEO.

stories.title: KPMG Australia consulting head Brad Miller departs
stories.summary: KPMG Australia national head of consulting Brad Miller is leaving the firm. His departure was announced to partners on Thursday morning. The firm has not yet named a replacement for the role.

stories.title: PwC India opens AI lab in Gurugram
stories.summary: PwC India has launched a Future AI Experience Lab in Gurugram, housing over 90 AI solutions for business testing. The facility allows companies to simulate scenarios using robotics and digital twins. The initiative draws on more than 500 client workshops and 200 internal accelerators.

Climate equity funding in India reaches 31 billion dollars
stories.summary: India attracted 31 billion dollars in climate equity funding between 2021 and October 2026, according to an IVCA and BCG report. Investment remains heavily concentrated, with 19 billion dollars directed toward power and low-carbon fuels and 9.5 billion dollars toward transport. Other sectors are currently lagging.

stories.title: BCG report says clean energy needs policy support
stories.summary: A BCG and IVCA report finds that battery storage, green hydrogen and bioenergy still depend on policy support to scale. While investment flows into established renewable energy, these emerging technologies face challenges in securing commercial returns. The transition requires more than just adding generation capacity.

stories.title: Inequality isn’t solved solely by increasing incomes - McKinsey & Company
BCG finds Indian employees lead in AI adoption
stories.summary: BCG reports that 96% of employees in India use AI regularly, the highest rate in the Asia-Pacific region. Indian workers report saving an average of 15 hours a week using AI tools, compared to the regional average of 9.4 hours. Adoption is now outpacing measurable business outcomes.

stories.title: India leads Asia-Pacific in workplace AI usage
stories.summary: A BCG report identifies India as the leading market for workplace AI adoption, with 96% of employees using the technology regularly. Indian workers save an average of 15 hours per week, significantly higher than the regional average of 9.4 hours. The survey covered employees across nine markets.

stories.title: InsurTech funding stabilizes as AI shifts focus to distribution
stories.summary: India’s InsurTech sector attracted 120 million dollars in funding, with 70% of investment directed toward distribution. BCG and the India InsurTech Association suggest this focus on distribution economics is a significant opportunity as AI reshapes the industry. Global distribution investment currently sits at 22%.

stories.title: BCG and CII target 100 billion dollars in textile exports
stories.summary: India’s textile industry aims for 100 billion dollars in exports by 2031, requiring annual growth of over 20%. A report by BCG and the Confederation of Indian Industry estimates the domestic market could reach 350 billion dollars by 2031. Exports currently represent 20% of the industry.

stories.title: McKinsey says half of large European industrials are stressed
stories.summary: McKinsey reports that approximately 50% of large European industrial firms were stressed or distressed in 2026. The firm notes that factory closures often occur when suppliers require payment before customers have settled their bills. Boards are currently using cash-gap forecasts to decide which sites to repair.

stories.title: McKinsey projects surge in Indian steel demand
stories.summary: McKinsey projects India's steel demand will reach 250 to 280 million tonnes by 2035. Expanding capacity to meet the government's 600 million tonne target will require an estimated 350 to 400 billion dollars in investment. Growth is expected to be driven by infrastructure and manufacturing.

stories.title: X-PM and BPG partner to combine interim and consulting capabilities
stories.summary: Interim management specialist X-PM and consultancy BPG have formed a strategic partnership to help businesses across Asia deliver transformation programs and improve operational performance. X-PM provides senior leaders on a temporary basis to manage complex projects, while BPG focuses on strategy implementation and business transformation.

stories.title: Dutch staffing firm YER buys AI-first developer 25Friday, adds 80 engineers - Dealroom
Japanese firm Dirbato acquires SAP player Icon Consulting Group
stories.summary: Japanese IT consulting firm Dirbato has acquired Singapore-based Icon Consulting Group. The target firm, which employs over 300 consultants across Asia-Pacific and the UK, reported 2025 revenues of SGD 50 million with an EBIT of approximately SGD 6 million. The buyer is calling it a family addition.

stories.title: APTIM sells commercial environmental consulting and remediation business to Trinity
stories.summary: APTIM has agreed to sell its commercial environmental consulting and site assessment businesses to Trinity Consultants. The deal will move about 550 professionals into Trinity's Natural Environment division. Trinity says the acquisition will serve retail, commercial and state clients.

stories.title: JMAC enhances manufacturing consulting with Toshiba’s digital visualization technology
stories.summary: Japanese management consultancy JMAC has adopted Toshiba’s Meister Apps Field Work Visualization Package to strengthen its manufacturing improvement services. Founded in 1942, the firm plans to use the technology to gain deeper insights into factory floor operations and develop more effective strategies for its clients.

stories.title: Oliver Wyman to acquire wealth tech consultancy Synpulse
stories.summary: Oliver Wyman has agreed to acquire Zurich-based Synpulse to expand its capabilities in wealth management and financial technology. The consultancy works with banks and insurers to navigate challenges driven by AI and data. The acquisition aims to build on an existing relationship between the two firms.

stories.title: ValOre to acquire Água Azul gold project in Brazil for US$135 million
stories.summary: ValOre Metals has signed an agreement to acquire the Água Azul gold project in Brazil from Opportunity Holding FIP Multiestratégia for US$135 million. The site includes an open-pit mine and a processing plant that has been producing gold since 2023. ValOre is now entering the gold market.

stories.title: Oliver Wyman to acquire FinTech consultancy Synpulse
stories.summary: Oliver Wyman has agreed to buy technology and AI consulting firm Synpulse to bring strategy and technology delivery under one roof. Financial terms were not disclosed, with completion expected in early 2027. The move follows increasing demand from financial institutions for help with digital transformation.

stories.title: Nexus Select Trust acquires Diamond Plaza mall in Kolkata
stories.summary: Blackstone-backed Nexus Select Trust has acquired the Diamond Plaza mall in Kolkata for Rs 355 crore. The transaction was concluded by real estate consultancy Anarock. The trust, which already manages the city's South City Mall, says the acquisition serves as an entry point into eastern India.

stories.title: PwC suggests India expand strategic reserves to include gas and LPG
stories.summary: India needs to expand its strategic energy reserves beyond crude oil to include natural gas and LPG to protect consumers from global price shocks, according to PwC India partner Manas Majumdar. The suggestion comes as the country looks to strengthen its storage infrastructure and energy security.

stories.title: PwC says India needs strategic gas and LPG reserves
stories.summary: India should expand its strategic energy reserves to include natural gas and LPG to safeguard against global supply disruptions, said PwC India partner Manas Majumdar. Speaking at an energy summit, Majumdar noted that recent events near the Strait of Hormuz highlight the need for diversified energy storage.

stories.title: EV charging infrastructure in India sees rapid scale-up
stories.summary: India recorded approximately 52,700 public chargers in July 2026, with 75 percent of the base concentrated in ten states. Projections indicate the number of stations could reach 90,700 by 2030. Deployment remains heavily influenced by vehicle density, urbanization and the purchasing power of specific regions.

stories.title: Private sector share in India's R&D spending rises to 45 percent
stories.summary: The private sector's contribution to India's research and development expenditure has risen to 45 percent, up from 30 percent a few years ago, according to NITI Aayog member Abhay Karandikar. Meanwhile, the public sector's share has dropped from 70 percent to 55 percent of total spending.

stories.title: Karnataka plans to decentralize economic growth
stories.summary: Karnataka is positioning Mangaluru as a regional hub to decentralize technology investments beyond Bengaluru under its Beyond Bengaluru initiative. IT and BT Minister Priyank Kharge stated the government's objective is to create multiple economic growth centers across the state to distribute employment opportunities.

stories.title: Deloitte India targets MSMEs with Project Bharat
stories.summary: Deloitte India is focusing on MSMEs and entrepreneurs in tier-2 cities through its Project Bharat initiative. CEO Romal Shetty noted that MSMEs contribute 36 percent of India's GDP and 49 percent of exports. The firm aims to provide technology-led services to these businesses to support national growth.

stories.title: Deloitte opens new office in Mangaluru
stories.summary: Deloitte India has opened its 27th office in the country in Mangaluru, initially housing 250 professionals with plans to reach 1,000 employees. The facility will serve as an integrated capability center for technology, AI, data, and consulting, connecting local talent to global client networks.

stories.title: PE and VC investments in India reach US$8.7 billion in October
stories.summary: Private equity and venture capital investments in India reached US$8.7 billion in October 2026, a 21 percent increase from September and the highest monthly level in five years, according to an EY-IVCA report. The number of deals also rose by 12 percent compared to the previous year.

stories.title: KPMG says Indian sports must be institution-led
stories.summary: India's sports industry is valued at US$21 billion and growing at 14 percent annually, yet cricket accounts for over 80 percent of the economy. KPMG partner Prasanth Shanthakumaran suggests that national federations must adopt standardized data and institutional models to build sustainable commercial success.

stories.title: IIM Ahmedabad summer placements 2026-27
stories.summary: The Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad has placed 414 students from its PGP Class of 2028. Consulting firms accounted for 191 of these offers, representing 46 percent of the total. More than 160 companies participated in the process, which concluded across three clusters.

stories.title: ISB PGP YL Second Cohort Records Strong Summer Internship Placements - Shiksha.com
Top recruiters at IIM Ahmedabad summer placements
stories.summary: Accenture Strategy, BCG, McKinsey, Alvarez and Marsal, Bain and Company, and Kearney were among the top recruiters for the PGP Class of 2028. All 414 students secured placements across 27 cohorts. Over 55 new companies participated in the process this year.

stories.title: IIM Ahmedabad completes summer placement process
stories.summary: IIM Ahmedabad has placed 414 students in summer internships for the 2026-27 academic year. Consulting emerged as the largest sector with 191 offers. The process included over 160 companies and offered roles in locations including Hong Kong and Singapore.

stories.title: Corporate career change to candle business
stories.summary: After seven years at Genpact, TCS, and Accenture, Shruti Kundan left her corporate career in 2023 to start a candle business. The venture has grown into a packaging operation reporting monthly sales between Rs 3 lakh and 5 lakh. Stability is a matter of perspective.
